Add diagnosis position flags

Source: R/dx-sensitivity.R
nis_flag_dx_position.Rd

Adds flags for a diagnosis prefix in the principal position, secondary positions only, and any position. Prefix matching and code-system eligibility follow nis_flag_dx().

Usage

nis_flag_dx_position(.data, code, name = "dx", system = c("icd10", "icd9"))

Arguments

.data

A data frame or lazy DuckDB query.

code

Non-missing character vector of diagnosis prefixes.

name

Base name for the added columns. The function adds <name>_principal, <name>_secondary_only, and <name>_any.

system

Code system of the diagnosis slots: "icd10" (default) or "icd9" (experimental, NIS 2012 to Q3 2015).

Value

.data with three logical diagnosis-position columns.

See also

Defining cohorts.

Other cohort-definition: nis_attrition(), nis_audit_code_transition(), nis_ccsr_codes(), nis_dx_sensitivity(), nis_flag_dx(), nis_flag_pr(), nis_flag_pr_timing(), nis_prday_completeness()

Examples

nis <- nis_open(nis_example(years = 2019))
